localTransport.summary: Thanjavur Old Bus Stand is about 0.5 km from both the Big Temple and the Saraswathi Mahal Library. The palace complex, which holds the library and the Art Gallery, is about 1 km from the temple. Auto rickshaws and buses run within town.

1.name: Brihadisvara Temple
1.hours: 6 am to 12:30 pm and 4 pm to 8:30 pm
1.dress: Dress code announced in December 2023 on a notice board put up by the HR&CE department and the Thanjavur Palace Devasthanam (DT Next report): men in a dhoti, or trousers and a shirt; women in a saree, half-saree or churidar with dupatta; children fully covered. Half trousers (shorts) and leggings are not allowed. A footwear safekeeping facility is provided in the complex.
1.shadeWater: Drinking water and toilets are provided for visitors.
1.notes: Working temple and UNESCO World Heritage Site. No official source on entry fees could be opened, so whether entry is free is not confirmed here. Entry to the Chola murals in the narrow passage around the sanctum is restricted. An interpretation centre runs along the south wall. Lonely Planet says official guides can be hired at the tourist information booth just outside the temple for 90-minute tours.

2.name: Thanjavur Palace
2.notes: About 1 km from the Big Temple. The Maratha royal family still lives in the palace. The main entrance is from the north, off East Main Street, where the main ticket office is. Seven sections can be visited. A 'Full' ticket covers the Art Gallery, the Saraswati Mahal Library Museum, the Maratha Durbar Hall, the bell tower and the Sarjah Madi. Other sections, such as the Royal Palace Museum and the Maharaja Serfoji Memorial Hall, need extra tickets (Lonely Planet). Current fee amounts could not be confirmed from an official source.

3.name: Saraswathi Mahal Library
3.hours: 10 am to 1 pm and 1:30 pm to 5:30 pm
3.notes: Inside the palace complex. Visitors see the library museum, which shows prints, paintings, world atlases, dictionaries and rare books; most of the books and palm-leaf manuscripts are not on display (Lonely Planet). The museum is included in the palace 'Full' ticket (Lonely Planet). An attached cinema room shows hourly audiovisual programmes, 10:30 am to 4:30 pm (Lonely Planet).

4.name: Thanjavur Art Gallery
4.hours: 9 am to 1 pm and 3 pm to 6 pm
4.notes: Officially the Raja Raja Chola Art Gallery. It is set around the Nayak palace courtyard behind the bell tower, inside the palace complex, and holds Chola bronzes and stone sculpture. It is included in the palace 'Full' ticket (Lonely Planet). Hours are from the Thanjavur district site (last updated 20.06.2023); the Ministry of Tourism page instead gives continuous hours of 9 am to 6 pm, so check locally. The Ministry of Tourism page lists photography as a facility.
